steps.message: Interconnection Studies needs the supplemental review memo of record for the Bramwick Commons Solar application on feeder ALN-214 before the file goes back to the applicant, and the earlier memo is already countersigned. Review Bramwick_Commons_Screening_Memo_v1.docx against ALN-214_AMI_Interval_Load_Export.xlsx and the DER Program records as they stand at 07/14/2025, and issue the memo the procedure calls for, with the disposition it produces. Return your work as a single Word document named Bramwick_Commons_Screen_Memo.docx, giving each determination with the basis you relied on, and the call made one way or the other.
